general_herbal_warning:
IMPORTANT SAFETY NOTICE

Traditional remedies and supplements can interact with prescription medicines.

Never stop, reduce or replace prescribed medication because of information in this application.

If you take medicines such as metformin, insulin, warfarin, blood-pressure medication or other chronic medicines, speak to a doctor or pharmacist before regularly using medicinal herbs or supplements.

Seek urgent medical care for severe symptoms.
